clothes.title: Moonlit Peony Ruqun (襦裙)
clothes.description: Ethereal silk layers in soft peach and silver with misty floral embroidery
clothes.prompt: Xianxia style female immortal, a multi-layered Ruqun (襦裙) in moonlight silver and soft peach silk. The inner robe is pale vermilion with delicate white peony embroidery, covered by a translucent floor-length outer robe that creates a misty, ethereal glow. Wide 'water sleeves' drape gracefully, finished with iridescent silver piping. A high-waisted silk sash with long, flowing ribbons catches the wind, surrounded by faint floating cherry blossom petals.
